architecture: DEFENSIVE strategy bank with causal market-state router
principles: Strategies may be specialized and need not trade every bear episode.
Router may use only causal market-state information available at decision time.
Episode identity, future morphology, future returns, and protected evidence are forbidden router inputs.
Cash/no-new-entry is a valid router output.
A strategy is judged conditional on its setup and routing domain, not by requiring universal activity.
No strategy may declare R1 or NORMAL.

bank_v1.role: candidate specialized mechanism; preserve observed damage/relative-state association without promotion
candidate specialized mechanism; preserve observed moderate-damage/strong-relative-state association without promotion
default when no validated routing domain applies

research_sequence: Map causal market-state occupancy when each candidate strategy setup occurs.
Test whether setup occurrence can be distinguished prospectively from market state alone.
Freeze a finite router family before comparing routed portfolio outcomes.
Use consumed six-bear development only until full bank and router are frozen.
